data.one_liner: Analytics, session replay, heatmaps, error capture, and surveys for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Cxorbi is an analytics and monitoring SDK for Flutter apps on iOS and Android. It captures wireframe session replays, heatmaps, screen views, gestures, performance metrics, error data, feature experiments, and in-app surveys.
use_when: You need session replay and heatmaps for iOS and Android Flutter apps
You want built-in support for feature flags, A/B testing, and in-app surveys
avoid_when: You are targeting web or desktop platforms
You prefer an open-source self-hosted analytics backend without third-party services
strengths: Comprehensive feature set including session replay, heatmaps, and error capture
Automatic screen tracking via navigator observers
Includes features for feature experiments and surveys
weaknesses: Does not support web or desktop platforms
Requires explicit opt-in user consent setup for production
data.setup_notes: No manual native Pod or Gradle setup is required for the default integration. Initialize Cxorbi in main() and add CxorbiNavigatorObserver.

alternatives.name: sentry_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you primarily need crash reporting, error tracking, and performance monitoring with deep Flutter integration.
